title: Continued oil and energy price surge
rationale: Energy price surge and oil rises jolt bond markets; Middle East turmoil rekindles inflation worries.

title: Fed September policy decision
rationale: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September; Warsh hints Fed may raise if inflation doesn't fall.

title: Treasury / investor yield‑capping actions
rationale: Coverage cites Bessent/Treasury interventions and talk of 'Operation Twist 2.0' to cap long‑term yields.

title: ECB September meeting (likely hike)
rationale: Euro zone inflation above 3% cements ECB rate-hike bets; top ECB official urges readiness to lift rates further.

title: BOJ September rate decision
rationale: BOJ chief signals chance of September rate hike; Japan faces day of policy reckoning after stimulus calls.

title: Sustained hawkish central‑bank communications
rationale: Warsh's Jackson Hole hawkish stance and ECB/BOJ signals keep markets pricing tighter policy and higher yields.

title: Rising fiscal financing pressure
rationale: Headlines note higher yields add tens of billions to G7 debt costs and strain UK/France bond markets.

title: Trading‑firm market‑structure strain
rationale: JPMorgan curbed lending to Jane Street as trading firm muscled into bond market, flagging liquidity and structure risks.
